focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體、電子材料、智慧工廠、資料中心電力
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asia semiconductors, electronics materials, smart factories and data-center power

throughline.zh: 新加坡跨國供電計畫取得條件性核准、騰輝泰國板材廠啟用出貨，以及 Viettel 晶圓廠建置與設備採購進度受到檢視，分別呈現電力、材料及前段製造的不同執行階段。
throughline.en: Singapore's conditional power-import approval, Tenghui's Thai factory opening and scrutiny of Viettel's fab construction mark distinct development stages for electricity, materials and wafer fabrication.

text.zh: 新加坡條件性核准 1.3GW 跨國供電計畫，2035 年開始輸電為目標，尚須融資與跨境許可。
text.en: Singapore approved a 1.3GW cross-border power import plan conditionally, targeting 2035, with financing and permits pending.

text.zh: 騰輝泰國銅箔基板廠正式開幕並小量出貨，年底量產及 2027 年擴產為規劃。
text.en: Tenghui's Thai copper-clad laminate plant opened and has shipped small volumes, with future ramps still planned.

text.zh: Reuters 實地指出 Viettel 越南晶圓廠基地尚無建築，ASML DUV 機台仍未成交；Viettel 維持既定計畫說法。
text.en: Reuters found no buildings at Viettel's fab site and no finalized ASML DUV deal; Viettel maintains its planned schedule.

text.zh: 鴻海與 NVIDIA 公布特定智慧工廠排程工時減少 25% 的實測成果。
text.en: Foxconn and NVIDIA reported a 25% scheduling labor-hour reduction in specified manufacturing workflows.

text.zh: ASMPT SMT 可能出售仍在洽談，尚未簽約；東京工具機展另有公會所述 94 家台廠參展。
text.en: ASMPT's SMT sale remains reported negotiations; Taiwan's machine-tool association reports 94 JIMTOF exhibitors.

title.zh: 新加坡有條件核准跨境進口電力 1.3GW，目標 2035 年開始供應
title.en: Singapore conditionally approves 1.3GW regional power imports, targeting 2035

summary.zh: EMA 於 10 月 26 日有條件核准 Sembcorp Utilities 輸入最多 1.3GW 低碳電力，規劃由越南與馬來西亞供應新加坡，目標 2035 年供電。計畫包含越南離岸風電及馬國太陽能與儲能，但仍待多國許可、購電協議及融資。
summary.en: Singapore's EMA conditionally approved Sembcorp Utilities on October 26 to import up to 1.3GW of low-carbon power from a proposed Vietnam-Malaysia-Singapore project, targeting 2035. Offshore wind, solar and storage are proposed sources; approvals, offtake contracts and financing remain pending.

text.zh: 跨國電力走廊涉及輸變電、電源轉換、儲能及資料中心供電。1.3GW 是有條件核准額度，並非實際併網或發電容量。
text.en: The corridor concerns transmission, conversion, storage and data-center power. The 1.3GW figure is approved conditionally, not commissioned capacity.

text.zh: 參與企業包括 Petronas、TNB 及越南 PTSC，早於 2025 年 5 月簽訂共同開發協議。10 月 26 日新增條件性核准，後續還須完成跨境許可與融資。
text.en: Partners include Petronas, TNB and PTSC, following a May 2025 development agreement. The October 26 approval is conditional, requiring further permits and financing.

text.zh: 實際線路場址、建設經費、購電價格與正式併網時程尚未確定。
text.en: Routes, capex, tariffs and commissioning timetable remain unconfirmed.

title.zh: 騰輝泰國 PCB 材料新廠啟用並小量出貨，年底量產為目標
title.en: Tenghui opens Thai PCB materials plant and starts small shipments

summary.zh: 騰輝電子 10 月 26 日在泰國大城府 Hi-Tech 工業園區啟用占地約 3.5 萬平方公尺的銅箔基板與黏合片工廠，已小量出貨。公司預計 2026 年底量產，2027 年增加上膠設備後，總設計產能目標再增加 15%，但絕對產量尚未公布。
summary.en: Tenghui Electronics opened a roughly 35,000-square-meter copper-clad laminate and prepreg factory at Hi-Tech Industrial Estate in Ayutthaya, Thailand, on October 26, and reported initial shipments. Volume production is targeted by end-2026, with a 15% design-capacity increase planned for 2027; absolute throughput was not disclosed.

text.zh: 銅箔基板與黏合片為多層 PCB、伺服器板件與汽車電子的上游材料，泰國廠是集團首座東南亞生產基地。啟用並小量出貨不等於已達量產良率。
text.en: Copper-clad laminates and prepregs are upstream inputs for server PCBs and automotive electronics. This is Tenghui's first Southeast Asian plant; initial shipments do not establish qualified high-volume output.

text.zh: 公司另提及 9 月核准的昆山廠 15 億元擴產計畫，該預算是既有中國工廠投資，不應計入本次泰國新廠資本支出。
text.en: The company also referenced a previously authorized NT$1.5 billion expansion of its Kunshan, China, plant. That earlier budget is separate from Thailand's factory opening.

text.zh: 泰國建廠投入金額、月出貨量、良率及客戶認證進度未公布。
text.en: Thai project capex, monthly shipments, yield and customer qualification remain undisclosed.

title.zh: Reuters：越南 Viettel 晶圓廠尚無廠房，DUV 設備採購未定案
title.en: Reuters: Viettel fab lacks buildings and DUV equipment deal remains pending

summary.zh: Reuters 10 月 26 日報導，越南 Viettel 在河內近郊規劃的首座晶圓廠，自 1 月動土以來尚未建起廠房，與 ASML 的 DUV 曝光機洽談亦未成交。知情人士認為 2027 年試產可能延後，但 Viettel 表示計畫仍依階段推進；目前沒有一致確認的新試產日期。
summary.en: Reuters reported October 26 that no buildings have been constructed at Viettel's planned wafer fab outside Hanoi since a January groundbreaking and talks to purchase a DUV lithography tool from ASML remain unresolved. Sources doubt the 2027 trial-production target, whereas Viettel says progress remains in line with its plan.

text.zh: 越南已有 Intel、Amkor、Hana Micron 等封裝測試基地，Viettel 計畫進入前段晶圓製造，將涉及微影、沉積、蝕刻、製程電源與無塵室設施。封測產能不能替代前段晶圓廠建設。
text.en: Vietnam already hosts Intel, Amkor and Hana Micron packaging/test sites. Viettel's proposed front-end fab would require lithography, deposition, etch, process power and utilities, distinct from installed packaging capacity.

text.zh: Reuters 實地查訪與衛星影像指出仍無建築，並報導越南當局先前估算建廠約 13 億美元、原定 2027 年試產及 2030 年全面運作。Viettel 回應計畫按階段推進，ASML 未確認設備合約。
text.en: Reuters' site visit and satellite images found no buildings. Authorities previously estimated US$1.3 billion cost, a 2027 trial and full operation by 2030. Viettel says phased progress continues, while ASML has not confirmed a contract.

text.zh: DUV 型號、正式採購合約、施工許可、製程技轉方及可查證的試產日期均未公布。
text.en: DUV tool type, a signed procurement contract, construction permits, technology partner and validated trial date remain unknown.

title.zh: 鴻海與 NVIDIA 公布智慧工廠實測：排程工時減 25%
title.en: Foxconn and NVIDIA report 25% lower scheduling labor hours

summary.zh: 鴻海與 NVIDIA 10 月 26 日公布特定智慧工廠流程數據，生產排程工時降低 25%，射出工程工作量降低 50%。DGX 平台的特定模型訓練速度為既有 H100 系統的 2.48 倍，尚未提供跨廠驗證。
summary.en: Foxconn and NVIDIA reported October 26 that scheduling labor hours fell 25% and molding engineering work fell 50% in selected manufacturing processes. A specified model-training task ran 2.48 times faster on DGX than an older H100 system; cross-factory validation was not disclosed.

text.zh: 製造應用涵蓋 SMT、排程、自動化、工業量測與伺服器 AI 訓練平台。
text.en: Applications span SMT, scheduling, automation, metrology and server AI training.

text.zh: NVIDIA 指出測試以既有 H100 平台為比較基準，且 12 天處理 1 兆 Token；流程改善數據不可視為整體工廠平均成效。
text.en: NVIDIA cites an H100 comparison and one trillion tokens processed over 12 days; selected workflow outcomes are not factory-wide averages.

text.zh: 受測廠區、絕對工時及產線良率比較資料未公布。
text.en: Test sites, absolute baseline hours and line yield data remain undisclosed.

title.zh: Reuters：ASMPT 的 SMT 業務出售仍在競標，尚無完成交易
title.en: Reuters: Bidding on ASMPT's SMT business continues with no signed sale

summary.zh: Reuters 10 月 26 日引述匿名人士稱，IDG Capital 在新加坡總部 ASMPT 的 SMT 事業洽購中較為領先，潛在交易價值可能逾 10 億美元，但尚未定案。ASMPT 於 2026 年 1 月啟動策略檢視，原始公告列出售、合資、分拆、上市或保留等多種選項。
summary.en: Reuters reported October 26 that IDG Capital was the leading bidder for Singapore-headquartered ASMPT's SMT business, with a potential deal value above US$1 billion, but no agreement finalized. ASMPT's January strategic review considered sale, joint venture, spin-off, listing or retention.

text.zh: SMT 設備涉及電子板件印刷、貼片、檢測及產線軟體，應用於 AI 伺服器、光收發器及汽車電子組裝。競標報導尚不能證明設備支援與保固安排將改變。
text.en: SMT equipment covers board printing, placement and inspection for servers, transceivers and electronics. Reported bidding does not establish service or warranty changes.

text.zh: Reuters 引述上半年業務數據：SMT 營收年增 53.1% 至 38.7 億港元，接單年增 87.8% 至 69.8 億港元。上述為上半年歷史實績，新消息僅是洽購進度。
text.en: Reuters cited H1 SMT revenue growth of 53.1% to HK$3.87 billion and bookings growth of 87.8% to HK$6.98 billion. Those are historical results; bidder progress is the new claim.

text.zh: 未簽正式出售合約，買方、價金、監管申報及員工安排均未證實。
text.en: No signed agreement, final buyer, price, regulatory filings or workforce plan confirmed.

title.en: JIMTOF opens in Tokyo with 94 Taiwan exhibitors, association says

summary.zh: 日本工具機展 JIMTOF 於 10 月 26 日在東京國際展示場開展，展期至 31 日。台灣工具機公會稱有 94 家台廠參展，包含 CNC、量測與工廠自動化設備；實際成交額及設備訂單未公布。
summary.en: JIMTOF opened October 26 at Tokyo Big Sight, running through October 31. Taiwan's machine-tool association reported 94 participating companies covering CNC, metrology and automation; new orders were not disclosed.

text.en: Precision machinery and controls support industrial automation and semiconductor tool components; exhibiting is not a signed order.

text.zh: 主辦方確認 10 月 26 至 31 日於 Tokyo Big Sight 舉行；公會參展家數由中央社轉述。
text.en: Organizer confirms October 26-31 at Tokyo Big Sight; exhibitor number was reported by CNA.

question.zh: 1.3GW 是已交付新加坡的電力嗎？
question.en: Is the 1.3GW already delivered to Singapore?

text.zh: 不是。EMA 公告的是有條件核准進口規模，計畫仍需跨境許可、購電合約及融資，2035 年也是預定開始供電時間。
text.en: No. EMA granted conditional import approval; cross-border permits, purchase contracts and financing remain, and 2035 is a proposed start.

question.zh: 泰國銅箔基板新廠開幕與量產有何不同？
question.en: How do the Thai opening and production ramp differ?

text.zh: 10 月 26 日已有啟用及小量出貨，但年底量產和 2027 年總設計產能增加 15% 仍屬目標，基準產能與良率未公布。
text.en: Opening and small shipments are realized; mass production and the 15% design-capacity expansion remain targets without reported qualified yields or base capacity.

question.zh: 越南晶圓廠 2027 年試產目標是否已定案？

text.zh: Reuters 實地與衛星查訪指出尚無建築，知情人士對時程提出疑慮；Viettel 表示按階段推進，缺少新的可查證試產時間。
text.en: Reuters' site findings raised timing concerns, while Viettel maintains phased progress; no newly verified trial-production milestone exists.

title.zh: 舊有擴廠新聞與股價評論

text.zh: 沒有 10 月 26 日新增簽約、核准或實際產出的舊有擴產資訊，以及僅評論股價走勢的報導，不列為新事件。
text.en: Previously reported expansions without new October 26 contracts, permits or operational output, and price-only commentary, were excluded.

verificationNote.zh: EMA 核准為條件性進口計畫，非已建成電力；騰輝小量出貨與未來擴產須區分。Reuters 報導的 Viettel 工程與設備洽談仍有不同說法。鴻海數據是指定流程的公司量測；ASMPT 買方尚無簽約證據；JIMTOF 台灣展商數由公會經媒體披露。
verificationNote.en: EMA's power approval is conditional, not installed capacity; Tenghui's shipments are distinct from targets. Viettel's construction and tool procurement remain contested. Foxconn data reflects company-measured workflows; ASMPT bids are unsigned, and JIMTOF exhibitor counts come from the association.
